% Invented fixture: block content inside overlay commands — the shapes a
% real deck steps. A list inside \onslide, a multi-paragraph \uncover,
% \pause between list items and inside a column, \alt's two alternatives,
% and an incremental spec the model cannot number (kept, with its warning).
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{slides}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{A list revealed whole}
\onslide<2->{
\begin{itemize}
\item Placeholder point one.
\item Placeholder point two.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Paragraphs revealed together}
\uncover<2>{
The first covered paragraph.

The second covered paragraph, revealed with it.
}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Paused list}
\begin{itemize}
\item Always here.
\pause
\item After one pause.
\pause
\item After two.
\end{itemize}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Paused column}
\begin{columns}
\begin{column}{0.5\textwidth}
Above the pause.

\pause
Below the pause.
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.5\textwidth}
The steady column.
\end{column}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Alternation}
\alt<2>{The second beat.}{The first beat.}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Incremental spec}
\onslide<+->{
\begin{itemize}
\item Shown on every step.
\end{itemize}
}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
